role: Preregistered controller-seed sensitivity; not primary model
selection: family-level validation; relevance retains 120-task selection-training fit; seed 0 fixed; seed sensitivity recorded

selector.architecture: gradient boosted conditional log continuation cost

selector_semantics: Conditional log attempt cost under fixed symbolic/hybrid/typed mode continuations with canonical P3 ties and fitted selected relevance. Greedy adaptive switching is a new rollout policy; censored costs excluded, success-conditioned missingness explicit. The fully linear reference uses a ridge controller with the same data; the applicability relevance ablation holds the selected controller fixed.
